blurb: Bear Trap Dunes Golf Club is a 27-hole golf course located in Ocean View, Delaware, featuring bentgrass fairways lined with native wetland grasses and sand dunes. The course offers four sets of tees for golfers of every skill level and is designed by Rick Jacobson. They provide private golf lessons, group lessons, and golf clinics for all ages and skill levels.
